subject.title: fix(publication): prevent batch preparation from overwhelming the state writer

question: Should the production publication path restore the four-concurrent-preparation cap now, accepting lower peak preparation fanout to protect the single state writer?
rationale: The configuration change is intentionally operational rather than a mechanically provable code fix: the remaining choice is whether the observed writer contention outweighs the reduced preparation capacity for this deployment.

options.title: Approve the four-worker cap
options.body: Merge the focused rollback after the remaining required check completes, then confirm writer queue delay and publication drain behavior from redacted deployment metrics.

options.title: Retain the eight-worker cap
options.body: Pause this PR if current production capacity requirements make the lower preparation fanout unacceptable without a broader admission-control design.

recommendation.title: Approve the four-worker cap
recommendation.body: Merge the focused rollback after the remaining required check completes, then confirm writer queue delay and publication drain behavior from redacted deployment metrics.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member who supplied the operational evidence and authored the narrowly scoped cap restoration.
